paper_title: New Limit on Axion-Like Dark Matter using Cold Neutrons
suggested_experiment_name: Beam EDM cold neutron ALP search
notes: Search for oscillating neutron EDM from ALP-gluon coupling using cold-neutron Ramsey apparatus. Primary result is C_G/(f_a m_a) in GeV^-2 (best limit 2.7e13 GeV^-2, 95% C.L.) over mass range 1e-19 to 4e-12 eV, best in 2e-17 to 2e-14 eV. The y-axis quantity is the gluon coupling/oscillating EDM, not d_n in e*cm directly, so the AxionEDM enum is an imperfect match — the reported coupling units are GeV^-2 (C_G/f_a m_a), not e*cm. Only the best-limit value is given numerically in text; full curve only in Fig.4. Could arguably be a distinct gluon-coupling category. rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed (deterministic).
